user.title: Add an Ashenmarch player
user.description: Paste a personal access token. Make one on your profile page ({portal_url}) under Personal access tokens: it is read-only and you can revoke it there at any time. Each player in the household adds their own token.

data_description.token: Starts with am_pat_. It is shown only once when you create it.

reauth_confirm.title: New token for {house}
reauth_confirm.description: Ashenmarch refused the token for {house} (revoked, expired or the account changed). Make a new one on your profile page ({portal_url}) and paste it here. Other players are not affected.

error.invalid_auth: Ashenmarch refused this token. Check that you copied all of it and that it hasn't been revoked.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Ashenmarch. Try again in a moment.

abort.reauth_successful: Token updated. Home Assistant is reading the realm again.
abort.wrong_player: That token belongs to a different player. Use a token from the same account.

init.title: Alerts
init.description: Alerts (sieges, holdings lost or won, fading soon) fire only for territory within the radius of the selected zones. Your own marches always fire. Default radius: {one_zone} {unit} for one zone, {many_zones} {unit} for two or more, until you type your own (default for {zone_count} zone(s): {default} {unit}).

data_description.zones: An alert fires when its territory is within the radius of any of these zones.
data_description.radius: Clear the field to go back to the default.

error.zones_required: Pick at least one zone, or choose All territories.

no_zones.title: Ashenmarch alerts for {house} have no zone
no_zones.description: None of the zones selected for {house}'s alerts exists any more, so alerts now come from all territories. Open Ashenmarch → Configure and pick a zone to limit them again.
